text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And then, the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby) arrived.
Tokyo Racecourse
was enveloped in tremendous excitement.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Told ya the number one favorite wasn't just for show!
She's on a graded race winning streak, so today's totally in the bag for her!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
"Nah, you don't get it at all.
Wanting to catch up to a legendary parent makes the best motivation! She's my only pick!"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Incredible.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"You can really feel all the hopes and dreams
everyone places on the girls who run."
choice_data_list: Because the Derby is also the audience's 'dream'
The Derby is the fans' 'dream' too, after all.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So, special...
I wonder if this is what Flash-san was talking about—

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: "Hey darling, why isn't this Eishin Flash girl popular? She's super strong, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator D
text_block_list.text:
Well, you see, honey, the other girls are just too strong.
Sure, she's got plenty of power, but not quite enough to beat the rest. For instance—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san.
Good luck...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"However, once the race actually began,
most expectations were completely overturned. In the final straight, bursting out from the chaotic pack was none other than—"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Eishin Flash breaks through!
Eishin Flash is pulling away!
She charges straight on... and crosses the finish line!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Carrying the hopes of tens of thousands!
This year's Derby Umamusume is...!
Eishin Flash!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOOOOOOAAAH~~!!
Eishin Flaaaash~~~!!!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...Incredible.
So this is...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: On the way home from the race. Concerned by Curren Chan's unusually quiet mood, we stopped by a park. And then...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren's been working really hard on social media lately, right?
Enough to make you worry, Big Brother."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Curren's been working really hard on social media lately, right?
Enough to make you worry, Big Sister."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, I'm really okay, you know?
Though to be honest... maybe I was a tiny bit anxious."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Is it really okay to focus only on sprints?
I feel like if I don't work hard at things besides racing too,
people won't pay any attention to me...
choice_data_list: ...Because sprint races don't get much attention?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Simply put, something like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I understand her concern. Even though short-distance
races can be wildly popular and exciting...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to Classic races like those on the Triple Crown route,
coverage in the various media outlets is smaller, and fan attention isn't at the very top."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
So Curren was thinking.
If Curren stands out a lot, wouldn't that also help promote the race?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Gather a crowd with Curren's charm, and captivate them with Curren's running...
There, problem solved♪ ...Or so I thought.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Still, things really weren't that easy, huh?
Today's race made me realize that.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
That wild frenzy... is something the current Curren
could never achieve.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san's smile looked more childish than usual...
It was so cute.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: "Overlapping with that smile was the shock I felt when I first watched a race."

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yes, Curren just wanted to...
find cuteness beyond all the wild excitement.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
“Still... has Curren's running up until now
really left an impression on someone's heart like that?”

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
At least...
it didn't leave an impression on Curren.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her eyes, brimming with frustration,
spoke with fierce conviction.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
As I am now, even if tons of people watch my races,
there's no way I'll be their absolute favorite.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Curren has to change, too.
I have to become... the cutest version of me!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I can't yet present what Curren Chan is seeking
as a concrete goal. But...
there is one thing that's crystal clear.
choice_data_list: In that case, we just have to get stronger.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash proved herself by winning.
Only the victor is permitted to claim
the title of number one.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Curren will... get stronger!
Time for training, Big Brother!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Curren will... get stronger!
Time for training, Big Sister!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"If you wanna get stronger, you've gotta push yourself
to the absolute limit.
That's why Curren needs some serious training right now!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Hearing her unique choice of words
gave me an idea.
choice_data_list: Then I have just the right training for you.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Really?
choice_data_list: It's the Summer Sprint Series, you know.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer was just around the corner. With the Classic campaigns taking
a brief hiatus, it was the season for the Umamusume
to dedicate themselves to honing their abilities.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I see. You race during the season
when fewer people are active,
and rack up experience that way.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, got it.
Over the summer, Curren is gonna get even cuter!
choice_data_list: First, it's the Hakodate Sprint Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the next goal was set: the first leg of the Summer Sprint Series, the Hakodate Sprint Stakes!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
All right~, it's decided! I'm gonna give it my all for our
"Hakodate Seafood Binge-Eating Training" project!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Just kidding! Tee-hee♪

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm definitely gonna get it.
If it's what I want, every last bit of it!
